title: How well do LLMs cite relevant medical references? An evaluation framework and analyses

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the agreement rate between human expert annotations and the GPT-4 based Source Verification model on statement-source pairs generated by GPT-4 versus pairs generated by a different model (Claude v2.1) to check if GPT-4 favors its own outputs.

Analyzing the country of origin of the cited URLs by performing WHOIS lookups and evaluating top-level domains (TLDs) to measure the proportion of US-based versus non-US-based medical sources generated by the models.
